DEAD CANYON

Canyon road. Dust haze. One chicane. Long desert speed.

ADVANCED
Format
Circuit · continuous laps
Length
≈ 3.30 km
Unlock
700 trophies · Advanced Tracks

Read the route

Red badlands, long desert speed and one tight chicane.

Find time

Treat the chicane as one sequence. Position for its last exit rather than attacking the first turn at maximum speed.

Practise here

Catch OVERCHARGE before the fast section and spend it with the car settled.

Try AWD and OVERCHARGE.
